feeds.title: French Law Group, LLC Blog
feeds.description: An Adjunct Professor of Law who has also represented 1000s of clients, Laura French of French Law Group offers news, tips, and insights on estate planning, trusts, and corporate and nonprofit law. We're in the business of protection, protecting your legacy, your family, your home, and your business. We understand that you may have questions about legal planning for your family or your business.

feeds.title: Aliant Blog
feeds.description: Aliant France provides corporate clients ranging from mid-sized to listed companies with legal assistance in both transactional and litigation matters. We provide our clients with a global vision of the legal issues at stake, taking into account social and economic realities. We deliver clear and concrete legal solutions. We have been providing information about the law!

feeds.title: French Law Consultancy Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest in French Law matters on our blog. John Kitching is also a contributor as a Legal Expert columnist for the well-known French Expat magazine Connexion France. We provide services on wills, inheritance tax, inheriting an estate, charities, estate planning, and many more!

feeds.title: Daniel Mainguy's Site
feeds.description: Read the Daniel Mainguy blog about legal news, distribution law, and legal theory! This blog is by Daniel Mainguy and it is for all his lawyers, students, colleagues, visitors, and friends. There is a bit of everything, lesson plans, TDs, courses, whole, as there used to be 'poly', etc., announcements of conferences, the Serge Lazareff Arbitration Competition, biographies of legal authors, some readers' reviews, etc.

feeds.title: Droit & Croissance
feeds.description: Droit & Croissance is a non-partisan think tank with an ambitious project: to transform our legal environment into a real engine for growth. We intend to promote the economic analysis of law, a multidisciplinary approach consisting in studying the economic effect of legal norms, to propose long-lasting and effective reforms of French law.

feeds.title: National Law Review » France
feeds.description: The National Law Review covers French domestic and cross-border legal matters of concern to international businesses. The National Law Review's contributors are regularly cited by other legal publications and mainstream media. We publish on emerging legal issues and many of our authors are from the nation's premier law firms.
